description: Manufacturers of Singapore HSA-licensed Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) / Chinese Proprietary Medicine products, aggregated from data.gov.sg with licensed-product counts and countries — the supply-chain view (who makes licensed CPM products, where). Optionally filter by country of manufacture or manufacturer name. An HSA licence is a safety-and-quality listing ONLY — it is NOT evidence the product treats any condition. The dataset carries no ingredients and no indications; it is a product inventory.

limit.description: Max manufacturers returned, 1-500 (default 50), sorted by licensed-product count

name: tcm_product_manufacturers
title: Tcm Product Manufacturers
